typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Critical Facility Class} as string,
		{Site Status} as string,
		{Co-Location Site} as string,
		{FHE Alias} as string,
		Alias as string,
		{Business Entity} as string,
		{MAC ID} as string,
		{Network Site ID} as string,
		Address as string,
		{Room Count} as string,
		{City } as string,
		State as string,
		Country as string,
		{Zip Code} as string,
		{Lease Date Owned} as string,
		{Site Manager} as string,
		{BCP Pairing} as string,
		{HRPM Vendor Group} as string,
		{Security Director} as string,
		{Security Supervisor} as string,
		{IPF Class} as string,
		{Site Lifecycle} as string,
		{On Board Year} as string,
		{On Board Date} as date,
		{Off Board Year} as string,
		{Off Board Date} as date,
		{Media Sweeps} as string,
		{Capacity Management Frequency} as string,
		{Capacity Management Service Model} as string,
		{DC Power Usage} as float,
		{DC Occupied Sq  Footage} as float,
		{DC Power Capacity} as float,
		{DC RU Capacity} as float,
		{DC RU Usage} as float,
		{Third Party Primary Contact Name} as string,
		{Third Party Primary Contact Email} as string,
		{Third Party Primary Contact Phone} as string,
		{Third Party Secondary Contact Name} as string,
		{Third Party Secondary Contact Phone} as string,
		{Third Party Secondary Contact Email} as string,
		{CPG CF Manager} as string,
		{DC Useable Sq  Footage} as float,
		{85% Outer Boundary} as string,
		Provider as string,
		Product as string,
		{Product Owner} as string,
		Region as string,
		{Access Area} as string,
		{Access System} as string,
		{Building Area} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(uploaddate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(FHE Alias != '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sink(input(
		AccessArea as string,
		SitePortfolioMgr as string,
		Product as string,
		DCOccupiedSqFootage as double,
		SecurityDirector as string,
		SiteLifecycle as string,
		MediaSweeps as string,
		{85perctOuterBoundary} as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PhysicalAddress as string,
		SecuritySupervisor as string,
		City as string,
		BCP as string,
		ThirdPartyPrimaryContactName as string,
		ThirdPartySecondaryEMail as string,
		BuildingArea as string,
		State as string,
		LeaseDateOwned as string,
		DataCenterAlias as string,
		Country as string,
		Region as string,
		OnBoardDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ProductOwner as string,
		CPGCFManager as string,
		BE as string,
		NetworkSiteID as string,
		OffBoardDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DCRUCapacity as double,
		IPFClass as string,
		DCUseableSqFootage as double,
		SiteStatus as string,
		ThirdPartyPrimaryPhone as string,
		MACID as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		AccessSystem as string,
		HRPMVendorGroup as string,
		OnBoardYear as string,
		OffBoardYear as string,
		ThirdPartySecondaryContactName as string,
		ThirdPartySecondaryPhone as string,
		CoLocationSite as string,
		ZipCode as string,
		CapacityManagementServiceModel as string,
		CriticalFacilityClass as string,
		DCPowerUsage as double,
		Provider as string,
		RoomsLocationsatthisSite as string,
		DCRUUsage as double,
		Alias as string,
		ThirdPartyPrimaryEMail as string,
		DCPowerCapacity as double,
		CapacityManagementFrequency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AccessArea = {Access Area},
		SitePortfolioMgr = {Site Manager},
		Product,
		DCOccupiedSqFootage = {DC Occupied Sq  Footage},
		SecurityDirector = {Security Director},
		SiteLifecycle = {Site Lifecycle},
		MediaSweeps = {Media Sweeps},
		{85perctOuterBoundary} = {85% Outer Boundary},
		UploadDate = uploaddate,
		PhysicalAddress = Address,
		SecuritySupervisor = {Security Supervisor},
		City = {City },
		BCP = {BCP Pairing},
		ThirdPartyPrimaryContactName = {Third Party Primary Contact Name},
		ThirdPartySecondaryEMail = {Third Party Secondary Contact Email},
		BuildingArea = {Building Area},
		State,
		LeaseDateOwned = {Lease Date Owned},
		DataCenterAlias = {FHE Alias},
		Country,
		Region,
		OnBoardDate = {On Board Date},
		ProductOwner = {Product Owner},
		CPGCFManager = {CPG CF Manager},
		BE = {Business Entity},
		NetworkSiteID = {Network Site ID},
		OffBoardDate = {Off Board Date},
		DCRUCapacity = {DC RU Capacity},
		IPFClass = {IPF Class},
		DCUseableSqFootage = {DC Useable Sq  Footage},
		SiteStatus = {Site Status},
		ThirdPartyPrimaryPhone = {Third Party Primary Contact Phone},
		MACID = {MAC ID},
		ETLUser,
		AccessSystem = {Access System},
		HRPMVendorGroup = {HRPM Vendor Group},
		OnBoardYear = {On Board Year},
		OffBoardYear = {Off Board Year},
		ThirdPartySecondaryContactName = {Third Party Secondary Contact Name},
		ThirdPartySecondaryPhone = {Third Party Secondary Contact Phone},
		CoLocationSite = {Co-Location Site},
		ZipCode = {Zip Code},
		CapacityManagementServiceModel = {Capacity Management Service Model},
		CriticalFacilityClass = {Critical Facility Class},
		DCPowerUsage = {DC Power Usage},
		Provider,
		RoomsLocationsatthisSite = {Room Count},
		DCRUUsage = {DC RU Usage},
		Alias,
		ThirdPartyPrimaryEMail = {Third Party Primary Contact Email},
		DCPowerCapacity = {DC Power Capacity},
		CapacityManagementFrequency = {Capacity Management Frequency}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
